programs.title: College Football

programs.title: College Football

programs.title: College Football
programs.desc: The No. 10 Bulldogs face the Tigers for the 130th time. Georgia leads the Deep South's Oldest Rivalry 65-56-8 after collecting an eighth straight series victory in 2024. Gunner Stockton created three TDs when Georgia thumped Kentucky 35-14 on Oct. 4.

programs.title: College Football
programs.desc: The No. 5 Rebels (6-0, 3-0 SEC) and No. 9 Bulldogs (5-1, 3-1) play a high-stakes game between the hedges. Ole Miss has won two of the last three meetings after a 28-10 victory in 2024, but Georgia won the last six get-togethers at Sanford Stadium.

programs.title: College Football
programs.desc: A storied rivalry sees No. 5 Georgia take on Florida in Jacksonville, Fla. The Bulldogs lead the all-time series 57-44-2, and won each the past four meetings by double-digit margins. Georgia comes off a 43-35 win over then-No. 5 Ole Miss on Oct. 18.

programs.title: College Football
programs.desc: No. 5 Georgia (7-1, 5-1) tries to maintain its grip on Mississippi State (5-4, 1-4) in an SEC battle of Bulldogs. Georgia has won five straight meetings, and 14 of the last 15. Mississippi State rallied for a 38-35 victory at Arkansas last week.

programs.title: College Football
programs.desc: The No. 5 Bulldogs host the No. 10 Longhorns. In 2024, Georgia beat Texas 30-15 in the regular season, and 22-19 in overtime in the SEC title game. Texas held off then-No. 9 Vanderbilt for a fourth straight win Nov. 1. Georgia has won five in a row.
